title: Police Respond After Man Exposes Himself To Kids Near Daycare
description:
On January 5th, 2023. Daycare staff shared that they witnessed a male subject walk to the front door of a daycare while exposing himself. Staff also stated he jiggled on the locked door handles, attempting to get inside the building. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Police Watch.
